latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of text-case-converter

- Easily convert file text to upper, lower, or title case via command line.
- Supports simple usage: specify file path and desired case (default is upper).
- Outputs conversion result with clear STATUS messages for success or errors.
- Requires Bash with tr and awk available.
